 By Mile High Sports via www.youtube.com, 11/13/2026 On the latest episode of Pickaxe and Roll, Ryan Blackburn discusses the first 10 games of the season and how Jamal Murray has stepped up to help the Denver Nuggets out of the gate. Blackburn discusses the Memphis Grizzlies game, Murray's top 10 level production, and if the Nuggets are in a good place or not to start the season.
